function: Over-the-air (AirComp) gradient aggregation for semi-federated learning: sets power scaling, normalizing factor and receive beamformers to manipulate aggregation distortion and cut energy (p. 1, p. 4).
system: BS with Nr=16 antennas and K=20 single-antenna devices, no RIS; 3GPP CDL fading; 23 dBm maximum power, 10 kHz bandwidth; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 12).
method: Semi-federated learning (FL plus split learning), supervised MLP, CNN and ResNet classifiers; AirComp parameters set by closed-form and DC-programming optimization, not learned (p. 1, p. 9-10, p. 12).
data_channel: Channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 clustered delay line model for gradient and data links; data: Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, IID and non-IID (p. 12-14).
test_conditions: Each setting is a separate training run on the same channel model and datasets; sweeps of epsilon1, Tmax and IID versus non-IID; K and Nr fixed (p. 12-14).
baselines: Learning: alpha-stable FL [29], MMSE&CI FL [50][51], own Algo. 2-only/3-only variants. Energy: MMSE&CI, SDR beamformer [42], Max TP, Max CPU, random data allocation (p. 12, 14, 15).
metrics: Classification accuracy versus training rounds; overall uploading and computing energy consumption in joules, also versus Tmax; energy saving percentages (p. 12-16).
complexity: Big-O order for Algorithm 2: O((K+2)N2 + (K+1)Nr^4.5 N1 N2 + (K+1)N2 + (K+1)^3 N2), similarly Algorithm 3; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 10, p. 12).
openness: none; no code or data link, only public Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 image datasets (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 12: "clustered delay line multiple-input multiple-output" (cites [44]); p. 17: "38.901, V16.1.0, 3GPP" is reference [44], the 3GPP channel model for 0.5 to 100 GHz.
q2_support: p. 13: "non-IID data decelerates the convergence of SemiFL compared to IID data" is a separate training run; epsilon1 sweeps (p. 13) and fixed K=20, Nr=16 (p. 12). No trained model is tested on an unseen scenario, band, dataset or configuration.
q3_support: p. 13: "SemiFL with proposed algorithms outperforms the widely adopted MMSE&CI FL scheme in all cases" (accuracy; alpha-stable FL [29] and MMSE&CI FL [50], [51] on p. 12); p. 16: "compared to SDR Beamformer and MMSE&CI" (energy, non-learned baselines).
q4_support: p. 10: "The main complexity of Algorithm 2 is given by O((K + 2)N2" (Algorithm 3 on p. 12); cost of the aggregation and resource design, not the model size.
q5_support: p. 12: "to classify the Fashion-MNIST [45], CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 datasets" are learning-task datasets only; channels are simulated with the CDL model; no code or data link is given in the paper.
notes: Title and DOI match on p. 1. Included as FL over the air: AirComp gradient aggregation, so the learned element is the model trained across devices (MLP, CNN, ResNet); the BS has 16 antennas, so the single-antenna rule does not apply; no RIS (reference [50] only). The aggregation design itself is optimization (closed form, DC programming, SDR), not learned. q1: CDL profile and carrier frequency are not stated. q3: the non-learned baselines (SDR beamformer, Max TP, Max CPU, RDA) appear only in the energy comparison; the accuracy comparison is against published aggregation designs. Extra results are in Appendix B of arXiv version [37], not in this PDF.
